text.content:
Pandemonium has a grim reputation: lightless, shrieking tunnels where visitors find only insanity or death. There are no planets or megastructures, just endless caves in black rock, kilometers wide at first, wide enough for docking ships, then narrowing to cracks. Hurricane winds roar through almost everywhere; the howl deafens, and the wind itself eventually drives anyone who stays too long mad. The sphere has no light at all beyond what visitors bring, and carrying a lamp marks you as a target for lunatics and things in the dark.

Gravity pulls toward an unknown core, so travel resembles caving; no one has come back sane from the center. Most passages carry streams of foul water, from trickles to torrents whose spray coats the air in oily mist and makes footing treacherous. Light reaches less than half its normal range before stopping dead, as if the darkness were solid. Entering the Umbra here is a terrible idea: its psychic landscape swarms with hungry predators.

Few people come here willingly, making Pandemonium one of the emptiest Crystal Spheres, and recent events have thinned it further. One of its rare permanent cities was destroyed by an unknown force, and what remained was so horrific that nearly every rescuer sent in was lost too. Something terrible lurks in the depths.

The Black Flag: a secret, armored and soundproofed pirate station where outlaws and shady traders hide from the law and swap goods and tales, since few governments will chase anyone here. Its master is the pirate king Atomsk, said to be capable of stealing whole planets. Ravenholm: once the largest city, a mining camp that welcomed anyone willing to behave and leave their past behind. A few years ago everyone there was slaughtered in one night, by daemons, a loosed artifact or contagious madness; the rescuers fell to the same psychosis.

Phlegethon: an unusually cold, colorful region of columns, stalactites and rock curtains, popular with sightseers but rumored to hold spirits and faeries that lure people away forever. Agathion: near the core, sealed cave bubbles in the rock, some airless, some with breaches spinning into small tornadoes. Rumor says the gods use them as vaults, and impossible objects are indeed found inside.

Story Master only: adventure seeds for this sphere.

A royal heir who ran away to be a pirate must be fetched from the Black Flag now that an assassin has killed her father, and the assassin is hunting her too. Whatever destroyed Ravenholm is spreading, as other outposts fall silent after sending terrified messages; it must be stopped before the sphere becomes a charnel house. Rumors also tell of a vast Aboleth and Mind Flayer city beside a hidden underground sea, which would menace the entire Great Wheel.
